title: Solid Glass: the Glass UI You Can Actually Read
niche: open-source design systems / AI app UI
status: Owner approved runners-up batch on 2026-10-15 for artifact-only videos. No public Release, no Buffer scheduling or posting. Approved Option-3 Chatterbox flow voice; no on-screen credit captions.
credits_on_screen: Own recreation and components card created for this video. Source links in post/description only. No on-screen credits.
verify_before_render: GitHub API checked 2026-10-15 10:31 UTC: 904 stars, 12 forks, created 2026-10-12, MIT license. 'Nine hundred stars in three days' is accurate at check time.
README: one stylesheet that restyles existing shadcn/ui components via data-slot/classes; components need no changes. Requires a shadcn/ui project (React 19, Tailwind CSS 4) — mandatory catch.
Registry badge states 13 items; agent-focused components include status-glyph, tool-steps, ask-card, context-ring, diff-view and composer. Install command shown is the README's own command.
Mandatory catch: the project is days old, so expect breaking changes; matures fast (pushed 2026-10-15).
Demo visual is our own recreation of the flat / solid glass / liquid glass idea; no repo screenshots copied. No on-screen credit captions.

scenes.heading: GLASS YOU CAN *READ*
scenes.sub: A design system for AI apps
scenes.say: This is a glass interface you can actually read. No squinting through the blur.

scenes.heading: MEET *SOLID GLASS*
scenes.say: It is Solid Glass, a new open-source design system for AI apps, built by DeepLethe.

scenes.heading: ONE *STYLESHEET*
scenes.say: It is one stylesheet. Your existing {shadcn|shad CN} components stay unchanged, in light and dark modes.

scenes.heading: DEVS *NOTICED*
scenes.label: GitHub · first three days
scenes.say: It pulled in nine hundred GitHub stars in its first three days.

scenes.heading: ONE *COMMAND*
scenes.say: Install it with one {shadcn|shad CN} command. The registry has thirteen ready-made items.

scenes.heading: BEFORE YOU *ADOPT IT*
scenes.say: The catches: you need the {shadcn|shad CN} stack with React and Tailwind, and the project is days old, so expect changes. On the plus side, it is {MIT|M I T} licensed, and your components stay untouched.
Building an AI app? Comment GLASS and I will pin the repo.

youtube.title: Solid Glass: the Glass UI You Can Actually Read
youtube.description:
Solid Glass is an MIT-licensed design system for AI applications: one stylesheet that restyles your existing shadcn/ui components, sitting between flat design and liquid glass so text stays readable. It gained 904 GitHub stars in its first three days. Catches: you need the shadcn/React/Tailwind stack, and the project is days old. Demo visual is our own recreation.
Source: https://github.com/deeplethe/solid-glass
